acceptance_criteria: A joining character appears on the SpawnLocation at (18, 0.3, 32) facing the Great Egg Tree before the profile loads; nobody is moved to a gate at join; `play` moves the loaded player to Plots.gate and is refused while racing; `home` unchanged (Studio, two clients, build stamp)

GardenProgress.login counts the day at load; a UTC day change while online applies loginTick once per session (clock moved in Studio: the WEEKLY card count rises without rejoining); the tick never counts a day twice across a flush re-apply

Deviations: spawn at (21, 0.3, 28), 5 studs from X2's (18, 0.3, 32) inside its 6-stud allowance, because the design spot is 7 studs from the 157.5 degree lamp post, not the assumed 12; the place file's Workspace.SpawnLocation is reused (moved to Workspace.Garden.Spawn) so no character can spawn before the script runs; the rollover tick checks each profile's weekLast/monthLast against today instead of a lastDay variable (same idempotent tick, also covers a load that ends across midnight); the large-sakura fallback is the generated `sakura` mesh scaled to height, then Props.sakura (lead's instruction; 4.7 said Props.sakura x1.6); the river had no water since v0.1 (terrain Water does not replace Sand), so the channel is now carved to Air before the water fill, as the pond is; Plots gains EGG_LOOKS weekly/monthly, FALLBACK colours for the six exclusives, and Lantern/Sakura fence and Lily pad looks for the login cosmetics.
